Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Crusade Columbia was won by the Toreador fighting under the hand
of Conor Key. Conor used his devastatingly beautiful but skittish
minions to rise to the top of the field of 15. Combat decks were
rampant, as they usually are in the Southeast tournaments, and the
two weenie decks (a dom-embrace-blood-gain deck and a
dom-misdirect-bleed deck) didn't finish in the top five.

In addition to the prize pack furnished by WotC, Conor received a
Protected Resources card (supplied by Joe Churchill, the Prince of
Columbia) and a $10 Heroes and Dragons gift certificate (supplied by
Heroes and Dragons).

Conor's winning deck (formatted by Elder Library Deck Builder):

Deck name: Aching Beauty
Created by: Conor Key
Description:
